Four acts: Title (01) — Problem (02) — Solution (03–09) — Demo (10–11).

The eyebrow on each slide names its act, so the structure reads even out of order.
Both figures here are marked [verify]. Confirm them against the IDA and CDC pages and drop the marker.

Slide 04 is the one the brief asks for by name: the same passage rendered two ways for two learners. ADHD gets the numbered checklist, dyslexia the labelled stages — matching the learner table in product_info.md.

Slide 07 is the one to read carefully. product_info.md says the fidelity flags are local seed data with no server claim map, so the slide now claims only what runs: the prompt constraints, the side-by-side source, and the human read. If Source Guard lands before you present, this slide is the one to rewrite.
